title: SXSW Partners With Egypt's UTH Festival to Connect Emerging Creative Talent
excerpt:
SXSW has named Egypt's UTH Festival its partner in the country.
A delegation of about 20 Egyptian industry participants is planned for the next Austin event.
body_md:
South by Southwest has established a formal partnership with Egypt's UTH Festival, making the youth-culture event its partner in the country. The arrangement is intended to connect emerging Egyptian filmmakers, musicians, content creators, founders and business leaders with SXSW's international professional network. It is a cultural and industry-development initiative rather than an announcement of a particular film production or festival selection.

The agreement follows the third edition of UTH, held November 20–21, 2026, at the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza. Organizers reported approximately 10,000 attendees. Under the theme Work in Progress, the festival brought together activities in film, music, fashion, design, the creator economy, food and sports, reflecting a broad definition of contemporary youth culture.

A concrete early component of the partnership is a planned Egyptian delegation of roughly 20 participants traveling to SXSW in Austin for its March 13–21, 2027 edition. UTH will curate and lead the group, drawing participants from film and music, content creation, entrepreneurship, investment and institutional sectors. The agreement also envisages a UTH-led programming session and a professional community gathering in Austin.

The two organizations are exploring further Egyptian participation in SXSW EDU and SXSW London in 2027. The specific formats of those possible activities remain under development. Another longer-term ambition is an Egypt House at SXSW, intended as a gathering point for Egyptian creative talent, companies and institutional partners in Austin.

UTH founder and chief executive Omar El Aawar said Egypt has abundant creative talent but needs more ways to connect that talent with the global industry. He described the partnership as a bridge that could help filmmakers, musicians and entrepreneurs reach audiences and collaborators beyond national borders. His stated ambition is to turn UTH from a two-day gathering into a year-round opportunity platform.

SXSW chief commercial officer Peter Lewis welcomed the collaboration as consistent with the Austin event's mission to connect creative people and support new ideas. He attended the Egyptian festival as the relationship took shape. While the partnership establishes a framework and an initial delegation plan, future programming details and any individual creative projects will require separate announcements.
seo_title: SXSW and Egypt's UTH Festival Announce Partnership
seo_description: SXSW partners with UTH Festival to connect Egyptian filmmakers, musicians and creators with global industry opportunities.
